intended_message: Get agreement on who owns the on-call rota.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: I think platform should own the on-call rota because they already own the alerting and the runbooks, and it would be cleaner to have one team accountable end to end rather than splitting it.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: I mean it just makes sense operationally, because otherwise we have two teams and nobody knows who's paged, and that's exactly the problem we had last quarter with the outage.
